# BlogItPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BlogItElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## Header

- **`Italiano (IT)`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogItElements` as `ITALIANO_IT_BUTTON`: `click().italianoIt()`.
- **`Accedi`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogItElements` as `ACCEDI_BUTTON`: `click().accedi()`.
- **`Prezzi`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogItElements` as `PREZZI_BUTTON`: `click().prezzi()`.
- **`Provalo gratis`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogItElements` as `PROVALO_GRATIS_BUTTON`: `click().provaloGratis()`.

## In the page

- **`Iscriviti al blog`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogItElements` as `ISCRIVITI_AL_BLOG_BUTTON`: `click().iscrivitiAlBlog()`.
